lines.text: Every year Tom buys his sister hiking gear, and every year she already owns it.
This year he gives her goals instead.
A 2027 year planner with a hike-a-week challenge,
a logbook for Colorado 14ers, New Hampshire 4,000-footers and the Adirondack High Peaks,
and a tracker for every national park.
She prints them that night and circles her first peak.
By January she has a plan for the whole year.
Save this for the hiker who has everything.
